title: Keynote at the International Conference on Learning Systems
excerpt: I was honoured to deliver the opening keynote on trustworthy multimodal AI, sharing results from our lab’s latest work on grounding language models in evidence.
content:
I was honoured to deliver the opening keynote on trustworthy multimodal AI, sharing results from our lab’s latest work on grounding language models in evidence.

Thank you to all collaborators, students and partners who made this possible. Feel free to get in touch if you would like to learn more or explore a collaboration.
